      "hello = world",
      "hello ()",
      "hello (>)",

      "libc",
      "libc (= 6)",
      "bar (= 1:1.0)",

    invalid.each do |i|

        original.provides << i

        insist { original.output(target) }.raises FPM::InvalidPackageConfiguration

      logger.warn("Replacing 'provides' entry #{provides} with syntax 'name (= version)'")
      provides = "#{m[1]} (= #{m[2]})"

    if m = provides.match(/^([^\s(]+)\s*(.*)$/)
      package_name = m[1]

          "(for example, 'name (= 1.0)')"
